author: Carlos Martinez
title: ISDE 2018 in Chile: My Motocross Clips
description: I filmed the 2018 ISDE in Viña del Mar, Chile: the final motocross on November 17, plus an enduro mass start.

sections.p: In November 2018 I filmed motorcycles at the FIM International Six Days Enduro, known as the ISDE, in Viña del Mar, Chile. It was the 93rd edition.
I filmed every clip here myself. My clips of the dirt track are dated November 17, 2018, the last day, which was the final motocross.
The 93rd ISDE ran from November 12 to 17, 2018. The first five days were enduro, and the last day was a motocross near Viña del Mar.
On the team side, Australia won the FIM World Trophy, the USA finished second and Italy third.

sections.p: Several clips repeat the action at 1/4 speed, so you can watch each moment a second time, slowly.

sections.h2: The closest thing in the sim

sections.p: iRacing has no motorcycles. The closest thing for loose-surface racing, on four wheels, is my guide to rallycross and dirt in iRacing.
